title: Iced Lemon Green Tea with Basil Seeds

ingredientGroups.title: Drink
items: ½ cup jasmine or green tea, chilled

steps: Prepare lemon basil seed mixture if necessary: Combine all ingredients in a small jar or cup and mix well to coat the seeds. Set aside for a few minutes until the basil seeds fluff and become gelatinous.
For the drink, add the ice and green tea to a medium-large cup. Add the lemon basil seed mixture and stir to combine. Adjust lemon basil seed mixture to your liking.
